policy: Capability status describes verified software scope, not scientific validity or hardware readiness.

capabilities.name: Electronics and SPICE
limitations: Bounded SPICE subset; not a complete EDA suite or hardware certification.
Browser execution depends on the production bundle resolving the SPICE dependency.

capabilities.name: IoT telemetry
limitations: Synthetic local telemetry and optional public MQTT demonstration; not a production IoT backend or safety controller.

capabilities.name: Browser machine learning
limitations: Synthetic sensor dataset only; no evidence of real-world predictive performance or calibrated safety probabilities.

capabilities.name: Differential-drive robotics
limitations: Planar kinematics and grid planning; no validated motor dynamics, wheel slip, ROS integration or safety-rated control.

capabilities.name: Quantum state visualization
limitations: Small state-vector demonstrations; not a fault-tolerant quantum computer simulator or hardware interface.
Research bridge validates ideal one-qubit unitary normalization and Bloch-vector invariants only; it does not model hardware noise, decoherence, entanglement, scalable circuits or quantum advantage.

capabilities.name: Molecular dynamics demonstration
limitations: Seeded two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model with velocity-Verlet integration, shifted pair potential and reflecting boundaries; all quantities use reduced units.
Not validated material-specific molecular dynamics, quantum chemistry, biological nanorobotics or research-grade thermodynamics; physical use requires validated potentials and convergence studies.

capabilities.name: Additive manufacturing estimator
limitations: Dimension-aware idealized cube, elliptical-cylinder and L-bracket envelope calculations; no imported CAD mesh, watertightness validation or true slicer toolpath.

FDM/pellet material and throughput use simplified shell, bead-width and layer-height assumptions; other process throughput defaults are illustrative, not machine-validated. Bioprinting is research overview only and is excluded from estimation.
Not CAD, production slicing, G-code generation, machine control, certified process planning or a supplier quotation.

capabilities.name: Internal research workspace
limitations: Internal browser demonstrations; not a public research hub, autonomous discovery engine or validated scientific workflow.

capabilities.name: MARIE metadata research monitor
limitations: Read-only selected-source metadata; no full-text claim extraction, comprehensive global coverage or proof of novelty.
